title: mirrorslope: Mirror Slope Plots for Two-Arm Clinical Trial Data
description: An R package that creates mirrored slope plots comparing two treatment arms over a single observation interval. Both arms share a common x-axis and converge at a central endpoint, making the between-arm gap the primary visual quantity. Returns standard ggplot2 objects. The display was designed by Kati Maharry and is described in Maharry and Sullivan (2026, manuscript in preparation).
